notes.title: Astral Towers released on Steam for the first time
notes.content:
Astral Towers is a card game with "one turn - one action" mechanic - like Spectromancer. But this is mostly an adventure game: there are 89 missions at 2 difficulty levels. 

The original game was made in 2011. It was English-only and designed for 1366x768 screen resolution, so it doesn't look great in full screen. Now the remastered edition has improved graphics designed for up to 4K screen resolution. 

Other changes:
[list]
[*] Improved UI and visualization.
[*] Full support for Russian language.
[*] Improved campaign balance based on actual stats.
[*] Steam achievements.
[*] No DRM, no any activations!
[/list]
I hope you'll like it and post a review! :-)

Game page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/983450/Astral_Towers/
